name: @bitcobblers/wod-wiki-playground
description: The wod.wiki web application — workout journal, canvas editor, review surfaces, and Chromecast receiver built on the Whiteboard Language packages.

scripts.build: bun ../../scripts/generate-agent-manifest.ts && bun ../../scripts/sync-seed.ts --app playground && bun run build:vite && bun ../../scripts/generate-static-shells.ts
scripts.build:api: bun ../../scripts/generate-agent-manifest.ts && bun ../../scripts/sync-seed.ts --app playground && bun run build:vite:api
scripts.test:all: bun run test && bun run test:components
